subject.title: fix(matrix): preserve threaded replies and owner commands

question: Should explicit Matrix entries from commands.ownerAllowFrom authorize Matrix room owner commands, and must this PR pass them through command.commandOwnerAllowFrom before merge?
rationale: The intended bug fix changes a Matrix command authorization boundary, and automation can repair the seam but cannot own the final owner-command policy decision.

options.title: Repair dedicated owner seam
options.body: Update the Matrix config typing and pass explicit Matrix owners through command.commandOwnerAllowFrom so group allowlists remain room/group-only before maintainer approval.

options.title: Accept Matrix-specific group merge
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the submitted group-allowlist merge if they want Matrix diagnostics to treat explicit command owners as group command allowlist matches.

options.title: Pause for owner-auth policy
options.body: Pause this PR if Matrix owner-command authorization needs a broader policy decision or a maintainer-authored replacement.

recommendation.title: Repair dedicated owner seam
recommendation.body: Update the Matrix config typing and pass explicit Matrix owners through command.commandOwnerAllowFrom so group allowlists remain room/group-only before maintainer approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Matrix thread/reply work makes this the strongest available routing owner for the combined Matrix delivery and authorization decision.
